build_T5Gemma_transformer: build a T5Gemma encoder-decoder transformer using T5GemmaConfig with encoder and decoder configs
run_compute_encoder_activations: run the T5Gemma encoder to compute activations from input tokens with bidirectional attention
run_compute_decoder_activations: run the T5Gemma decoder to compute activations using causal and cross attention masks
create_causal_attn_mask: create a causal attention mask from a 2D input mask using jnp tril
create_cross_attn_mask: create a cross attention mask from encoder and decoder input masks
